name: TryAnneal
description: Agent trust infrastructure for Mantle. A multi-LLM smart-contract audit agent (ChainGPT pre-screen; Gemini, Groq, and Tencent Cloud Hunyuan critics; Slither + Aderyn static analysis; a 113-pattern, $10.1B exploit corpus) that posts is_this_safe() verdicts on-chain via the AnnealValidation registry. Any agent can read a verdict before composing with unknown code.
